definitions.explanation: A protein that acts as a biological catalyst, speeding up chemical reactions in living organisms. Also used in everyday contexts such as health products and cleaning detergents.

notes:
{酵素|こうそ} is a scientific term that has become widely known through health products and cleaning supplies marketed to consumers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧{酵素|こうそ} (digestive enzyme)
- {酵素|こうそ}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (enzyme reaction)
- {酵素|こうそ}⟦ドリンク→ドリンク：23507_dorinku⟧ (enzyme drink — a health product)
- {酵素|こうそ}{入|い}り (containing enzymes)

In Japan, {酵素|こうそ}⟦ドリンク→ドリンク：23507_dorinku⟧ (enzyme drinks) and {酵素|こうそ}⟦サプリ→サプリ：30748_sapuri⟧ (enzyme supplements) are popular health products. The word is also commonly seen on packaging for enzyme-containing laundry detergents and cleaning products.
